future_record_schema.row_unit: one arm × seed × task/checkpoint × phase × repeat

proposed_measurement_controls.condition: Audited event definitions per source loop and architecture, matching training vs heldout inference scopes
Instrumented/uninstrumented paired timing on same future host; counter observer overhead recorded
Predefine warmup/repeat count, order randomization, monotonic clock, RSS scope and machine load policy
Same data and initialization with independently reviewed dtype, tolerance and per-step trace check
Train-only calibration and frozen heldout accuracy checks before interpreting costs
Freeze any event-to-work weights independently before collecting results; until then disclose separate raw event categories
Pin commit, per-seed dataset digests, environment and complete failures/retries
Independent scientific review and Marcus's separately explicit workload authorization before model execution

reporting_policy: Report by arm and phase, never collapse training and inference into a single energy figure
Report per-seed signed paired effects and range; five seeds descriptive only
Record missing/failed rows, no cherry-picked exclusions
Distinguish proposed static proxies from future observed software events
Keep electrical joules and Loihi/Q.ANT energy NOT_MEASURED
next_step: Independent review of event instrumentation definitions, paired numeric tolerances, and learnability calibration; no execution in CL-9C.
